shortDescription: Creates a resource of Ecs/Instance in Huawei Cloud

options.name: admin_pass
options.description: Specifies the initial login password of the administrator account for logging in to an ECS using password authentication. The Linux administrator is root, and the Windows administrator is Administrator. Password complexity requirements, consists of 8 to 26 characters. The password must contain at least three of the following character types 'uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters (V(!@$%^-_=+[{}]:,./?))'. The password cannot contain the username or the username in r

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Specifies the name of the AZ where the ECS is located.

options.name: data_volumes
options.description: Specifies the data disks of ECS instance.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the description of an ECS, which is a null string by default. Can contain a maximum of 85 characters. Cannot contain special characters, such as V(<) and V(>).

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

options.name: eip_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the elastic IP address assigned to the ECS. Only elastic IP addresses in the DOWN state can be assigned.

options.name: enable_auto_recovery
options.description: Specifies whether automatic recovery is enabled on the ECS.

options.name: enterprise_project_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the enterprise project to which the ECS belongs.

options.name: flavor_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the system flavor.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: The Identity authentication URL.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the system image.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the ECS name. Value requirements consists of 1 to 64 characters, including letters, digits, underscores (V(_)), hyphens (V(-)), periods (V(.)).

options.name: nics
options.description: Specifies the NIC information of the ECS. Constraints the network of the NIC must belong to the VPC specified by vpc_id. A maximum of 12 NICs can be attached to an ECS.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to login with.

options.name: project
options.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

options.name: region
options.description: The region to which the project belongs.

options.name: root_volume
options.description: Specifies the configuration of the ECS's system disks.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: Specifies the security groups of the ECS. If this parameter is left blank, the default security group is bound to the ECS by default.

options.name: server_metadata
options.description: Specifies the metadata of ECS to be created.

options.name: server_tags
options.description: Specifies the tags of an ECS. When you create ECSs, one ECS supports up to 10 tags.

options.name: ssh_key_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SSH key used for logging in to the ECS.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: The timeouts for each operations.

options.name: user
options.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Specifies the user data to be injected during the ECS creation process. Text, text files, and gzip files can be injected. The content to be injected must be encoded with base64. The maximum size of the content to be injected (before encoding) is 32 KB. For Linux ECSs, this parameter does not take effect when adminPass is used.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the VPC to which the ECS belongs.
